subject.title: [Feature Request] Add option to disable 'new messages' notification banner in WebChat

question: Should WebChat add a separate New messages indicator mode, and should that live as browser-local UI state instead of an openclaw.json gateway config key?
rationale: The code path is clear, but the behavior changes a visible catch-up affordance and the requested config shape conflicts with the retired WebChat config surface.

options.title: Browser-local indicator mode
options.body: Add a persisted Control UI/WebChat setting for indicator behavior while keeping gateway.webchat retired and retaining an accessible catch-up action.

options.title: No separate banner setting
options.body: Treat existing auto-scroll modes as sufficient and leave the New messages control as the supported catch-up affordance.

options.title: Gateway config surface
options.body: Reopen and document a WebChat config key with schema and doctor implications if maintainers want operator-level policy instead of per-browser preference.

recommendation.title: Browser-local indicator mode
recommendation.body: Add a persisted Control UI/WebChat setting for indicator behavior while keeping gateway.webchat retired and retaining an accessible catch-up action.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev owns the recent auto-scroll selector context and has already identified this issue as a separate indicator product decision.
